 64	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 65	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 66	
 67	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 68	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 69	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 70	 .stream()
 71	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 72	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 73	
 74	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 75	 return null; // 队列为空
 76	 }
 77	
 78	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 79	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 80	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 81	
 82	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 83	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 84	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 85	
 86	 return patientId;

 118	<script>
 119	import { getDoctorsByDepartment } from '@/api/department.js';
 120	import { getDoctorList } from '@/api/doctor.js';
 121	
 122	export default {
 123		data() {
 124			return {
 125				departmentId: null,
 126				departmentName: '',
 127				doctors: [],
 128				selectedTitle: '',
 129				sortType: 'default',
 130				showTitlePopup: false,
 131				showSortPopup: false,
 132				titleOptions: ['主任医师', '副主任医师', '主治医师', '住院医师'],
 133				sortOptions: [
 134					{ key: 'default', name: '默认排序' },
 135					{ key: 'title', name: '职称优先' },
 136					{ key: 'fee', name: '费用从低到高' }
 137				],
 138				loading: false
 139			};
 140		},
 141		computed: {
 142			filteredDoctors() {
 143				let result = [...this.doctors];
 144				
 145				// 职称筛选
 146				if (this.selectedTitle) {
 147					result = result.filter(doctor => doctor.title === this.selectedTitle);
 148				}
 149				
 150				// 排序：优先展示今日坐诊的医生
 151				const titleOrder = ['主任医师', '副主任医师', '主治医师', '住院医师'];
 152				result.sort((a, b) => {
 153					const dutyDiff = (b.onDutyToday ? 1 : 0) - (a.onDutyToday ? 1 : 0);
 154					if (dutyDiff !== 0) {
 155						return dutyDiff;
 156					}
 157					if (this.sortType === 'title') {
 158						return titleOrder.indexOf(a.title) - titleOrder.indexOf(b.title);
 159					}
 160					if (this.sortType === 'fee') {
 161						return (a.registrationFee || 0) - (b.registrationFee || 0);
 162					}
 163					return 0;
 164				});
 165				
 166				return result;
 167			}
 168		},
 169		onLoad(options) {
 170			if (options.departmentId !== undefined) {
 171				const parsedId = Number(options.departmentId);
 172				this.departmentId = Number.isNaN(parsedId) ? null : parsedId;
 173			}
 174			if (options.departmentName) {
 175				this.departmentName = decodeURIComponent(options.departmentName);
 176			}
 177			this.loadDoctors();
 178		},
 179		methods: {
 180			// 加载医生列表
 181			async loadDoctors() {
 182				this.loading = true;
 183				try {
 184					if (this.departmentId !== null && this.departmentId !== undefined) {
 185						let list = await getDoctorsByDepartment(this.departmentId).catch(() => null);
 186						if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) {
 187							const allDoctors = await getDoctorList();
 188							list = this.filterDoctorsByDepartment(allDoctors, this.departmentId);
 189						}
 190						this.doctors = this.normalizeDoctorList(list);
 191					} else {
 192						const data = await getDoctorList();
 193						this.doctors = this.normalizeDoctorList(data);
 194					}
 195				} catch (error) {
 196					console.error('加载医生列表失败:', error);
 197					this.doctors = [];
 198					uni.showToast({
 199						title: error.msg || '加载失败',
 200						icon: 'none'
 201					});
 202				} finally {
 203					this.loading = false;
 204				}
 205			},
 206			
 207			// 显示职称筛选
 208			showTitleFilter() {
 209				this.showTitlePopup = true;
 210			},
 211			
 212			// 显示排序筛选
 213			showSortFilter() {
 214				this.showSortPopup = true;
 215			},
 216			
 217			// 选择职称
 218			selectTitle(title) {
 219				this.selectedTitle = title;
 220				this.showTitlePopup = false;
 221			},
 222			
 223			// 选择排序
 224			selectSort(type) {
 225				this.sortType = type;
 226				this.showSortPopup = false;
 227			},
 228	
 229			normalizeDoctorList(list) {
 230				if (!Array.isArray(list)) {
 231					return [];
 232				}
 233				return list
 234					.filter(item => item && item.id)
 235					.map(item => ({
 236						...item,
 237						onDutyToday: !!item.onDutyToday
 238					}));
 239			},
 240	
 241			filterDoctorsByDepartment(list, departmentId) {
 242				if (!Array.isArray(list)) {
 243					return [];
 244				}
 245				return list.filter(doctor => {
 246					const clinic = doctor?.clinic;
 247					if (!clinic) return false;
 248					const deptId = Number(clinic.departmentId);
 249					return !Number.isNaN(deptId) && deptId === Number(departmentId);
 250				});
 251			},
 252			
 253			// 获取排序名称
 254			getSortName(key) {
 255				const option = this.sortOptions.find(item => item.key === key);
 256				return option ? option.name : '';
 257			},
 258			
 259			// 获取职称样式类
 260			getTitleClass(title) {
 261				if (title === '主任医师') return 'senior';
 262				if (title === '副主任医师') return 'associate';
 263				return '';
 264			},
 265			
 266			// 获取挂号费（暂时返回默认值）
 267			getRegistrationFee(doctor) {
 268				// 根据职称返回不同挂号费
 269				if (doctor.title === '主任医师') return 50;
 270				if (doctor.title === '副主任医师') return 30;
 271				if (doctor.title === '主治医师') return 20;
 272				return 15;
 273			},
 274			
 275			// 跳转到医生详情
 276			goToDoctorDetail(doctor) {
 277				uni.navigateTo({
 278					url: `/pages/doctor-detail/doctor-detail?doctorId=${doctor.id}`
 279				});
 280			}
 281		}
 282	};

 73	<script>
 74	import { getMyWaitlist, cancelWaitlist } from '@/api/waitlist.js'
 75	import { getScheduleDetailsById } from '@/api/schedule.js'
 76	
 77	export default {
 78		name: 'MySubstitute',
 79		data() {
 80			return {
 81				waitlists: [],
 82				currentFilter: 'all', // 默认显示全部候补记录
 83				loading: false
 84			};
 85		},
 86		computed: {
 87			// 根据筛选条件过滤列表
 88			filteredList() {
 89				if (this.currentFilter === 'all') {
 90					return this.waitlists;
 91				} else if (this.currentFilter === 'waiting') {
 92					// 只显示候补中的记录
 93					return this.waitlists.filter(item => item.status === 'WAITING');
 94				} else if (this.currentFilter === 'success') {
 95					// 只显示已成功的记录
 96					return this.waitlists.filter(item => item.status === 'SUCCESS');
 97				}
 98				return this.waitlists;
 99			}
 100		},
 101		onLoad() {
 102			// 从全局状态获取筛选条件
 103			const filter = getApp().globalData.waitlistFilter;
 104			if (filter) {
 105				this.currentFilter = filter;
 106				// 清除全局状态
 107				getApp().globalData.waitlistFilter = null;
 108			}
 109		},
 110		onShow() {
 111			// 检查是否已登录
 112			const token = this.$store.state.user.token;
 113			if (!token) {
 114				uni.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
 115				// 延迟跳转到登录页面
 116				setTimeout(() => {
 117					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login' });
 118				}, 1000);
 119				return;
 120			}
 121			
 122			this.loadData();
 123		},
 124		methods: {
 125			async loadData() {
 126				this.loading = true;
 127				try {
 128					// 获取候补记录
 129					const waitlistData = await getMyWaitlist();
 130					console.log('候补列表数据:', waitlistData);
 131	
 132					// 处理候补记录数据，并获取每个排班的详细信息
 133					if (Array.isArray(waitlistData) && waitlistData.length > 0) {
 134						// 并行获取所有排班的详细信息
 135						const detailsPromises = waitlistData.map(item =>
 136							getScheduleDetailsById(item.scheduleId)
 137								.then(details => ({
 138									...item,
 139									status: 'WAITING', // 候补状态
 140									doctorName: details.doctorName || '未知医生',
 141									scheduleDate: this.formatDate(details.scheduleDate) || '未知日期',
 142									timeSlot: details.timeSlot,
 143									timeSlotDisplay: this.getTimeSlotDisplay(details.timeSlot) || '未知时间',
 144									departmentName: details.departmentName || '未知科室'
 145								}))
 146								.catch(err => {
 147									console.error(`获取排班${item.scheduleId}详情失败:`, err);
 148									// 如果获取失败，返回默认值
 149									return {
 150										...item,
 151										status: 'WAITING',
 152										doctorName: '未知医生',
 153										scheduleDate: '未知日期',
 154										timeSlotDisplay: '未知时间',
 155										departmentName: '未知科室'
 156									};
 157								})
 158						);
 159	
 160						this.waitlists = await Promise.all(detailsPromises);
 161					} else {
 162						this.waitlists = [];
 163					}
 164	
 165					console.log('处理后的候补列表:', this.waitlists);
 166				} catch (e) {
 167					console.error('加载候补数据失败:', e);
 168					uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '加载失败', icon: 'none' });
 169				} finally {
 170					this.loading = false;
 171				}
 172			},
 173			// 筛选候补记录
 174			filterWaitlists(type) {
 175				this.currentFilter = type;
 176			},
 177			// 获取状态文本
 178			getStatusText(status) {
 179				switch (status) {
 180					case 'WAITING': return '候补中';
 181					case 'SUCCESS': return '已成功';
 182					case 'CANCELLED': return '已取消';
 183					default: return status || '-';
 184				}
 185			},
 186			// 获取状态样式类
 187			getStatusClass(status) {
 188				return String(status || '').toLowerCase();
 189			},
 190			// 退出候补
 191			async cancelWaitlist(item) {
 192				uni.showModal({
 193					title: '退出候补',
 194					content: '确定要退出候补吗？退出后将无法恢复',
 195					confirmText: '确认退出',
 196					confirmColor: '#f44336',
 197					success: async (res) => {
 198						if (res.confirm) {
 199							try {
 200								await cancelWaitlist(item.scheduleId);
 201								uni.showToast({ title: '已退出候补', icon: 'success' });
 202								this.loadData();
 203							} catch (e) {
 204								uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '退出失败', icon: 'none' });
 205							}
 206						}
 207					}
 208				});
 209			},
 210			// 查看详情
 211			viewDetail(item) {
 212				// 跳转到候补详情页
 213				uni.navigateTo({
 214					url: `/pages/waitlist/waitlist?scheduleId=${item.scheduleId}`
 215				});
 216			},
 217			// 格式化日期
 218			formatDate(dateStr) {
 219				if (!dateStr) return '';
 220				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 221				const year = date.getFullYear();
 222				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 223				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 224				return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
 225			},
 226			// 获取时间段显示文本
 227			getTimeSlotDisplay(timeSlot) {
 228				if (!timeSlot) return '';
 229				const lowerCaseTimeSlot = timeSlot.toLowerCase();
 230				const timeSlotMap = {
 231					'morning': '上午',
 232					'afternoon': '下午',
 233					'evening': '晚上'
 234				};
 235				return timeSlotMap[lowerCaseTimeSlot] || timeSlot || '';
 236			}
 237		}
 238	};

 25	 public List<ScheduleDTO> getWeekSchedule() {

 103	 public Map<String, Object> batchCreateSchedule(BatchScheduleRequest request) {
 104	 // 1. 验证医生是否存在
 105	 if (doctorMapper.selectById(request.getDoctorId()) == null) {
 106	 throw new RuntimeException("医生不存在");
 107	 }
 108	
 109	 // 2. 验证日期范围
 110	 if (request.getEndDate().before(request.getStartDate())) {

 112	 }

 114	 // 3. 生成日期列表

 119	 request.getExcludeDates()
 120	 );
 121	
 122	 // 4. 批量创建排班
 123	 int successCount = 0;
 124	 int skipCount = 0;
 125	 List<String> errors = new ArrayList<>();
 126	
 127	 for (Date date : dateList) {
 128	 for (String timeSlot : request.getTimeSlots()) {
 129	 try {
 130	 // 检查是否已存在
 131	 int exists = scheduleMapper.checkScheduleExists(
 132	 request.getDoctorId(), date, timeSlot
 133	 );
 134	 if (exists > 0) {
 135	 skipCount++;
 136	 continue;
 137	 }
 138	
 139	 // 创建排班
 140	 Schedule schedule = new Schedule();
 141	 schedule.setDoctorId(request.getDoctorId());
 142	 schedule.setScheduleDate(date);
 143	 schedule.setTimeSlot(timeSlot);
 144	 schedule.setSlotType(request.getSlotType());
 145	 schedule.setTotalSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 146	 schedule.setAvailableSlots(request.getTotalSlots());
 147	
 148	 scheduleMapper.insert(schedule);
 149	 successCount++;
 150	 } catch (Exception e) {
 151	 errors.add(String.format("日期 %s 时段 %s 创建失败: %s", date, timeSlot, e.getMessage()));
 152	 }
 153	 }
 154	 }
 155	
 156	 // 5. 返回结果
 157	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 158	 result.put("successCount", successCount);
 159	 result.put("skipCount", skipCount);
 160	 result.put("errorCount", errors.size());
 161	 result.put("errors", errors);
 162	 result.put("message", String.format("成功创建 %d 个排班，跳过 %d 个已存在的排班", successCount, skipCount));
 163	
 164	 return result;
 165	 }

 254	 public Map<String, Object> querySchedules(ScheduleQueryRequest request) {

 261	 request.getTimeSlot(),
 262	 request.getSlotType()
 263	 );
 264	
 265	 // 2. 统计总数
 266	 int total = scheduleMapper.countByConditions(
 267	 request.getDoctorId(),
 268	 request.getDepartmentId(),
 269	 request.getStartDate(),
 270	 request.getEndDate(),
 271	 request.getTimeSlot(),
 272	 request.getSlotType()
 273	 );
 274	
 275	 // 3. 分页处理
 276	 int page = request.getPage();
 277	 int pageSize = request.getPageSize();
 278	 int startIndex = (page - 1) * pageSize;
 279	 int endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + pageSize, schedules.size());
 280	 
 281	 List<ScheduleWithDetailsDTO> pagedSchedules = schedules.subList(startIndex, endIndex);
 282	
 283	 // 4. 返回结果
 284	 Map<String, Object> result = new HashMap<>();
 285	 result.put("list", pagedSchedules);
 286	 result.put("total", total);
 287	 result.put("page", page);
 288	 result.put("pageSize", pageSize);
 289	 result.put("totalPages", (total + pageSize - 1) / pageSize);

 291	 return result;

 308	 /**
 309	 * 生成日期列表（批量创建排班时使用）
 310	 */
 311	 private List<Date> generateDateList(Date startDate, Date endDate, Boolean skipWeekends, List<Date> excludeDates) {
 312	 List<Date> dateList = new ArrayList<>();
 313	 Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
 314	 calendar.setTime(startDate);
 315	 calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
 316	 calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
 317	 calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
 318	 calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
 319	
 320	 while (!calendar.getTime().after(endDate)) {
 321	 Date currentDate = calendar.getTime();
 322	 
 323	 // 检查是否需要跳过周末
 324	 if (skipWeekends != null && skipWeekends) {
 325	 int dayOfWeek = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 326	 if (dayOfWeek == Calendar.SATURDAY || dayOfWeek == Calendar.SUNDAY) {
 327	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 328	 continue;
 329	 }
 330	 }
 331	 
 332	 // 检查是否在排除日期中
 333	 boolean isExcluded = false;
 334	 if (excludeDates != null) {
 335	 for (Date excludeDate : excludeDates) {
 336	 Calendar excludeCal = Calendar.getInstance();
 337	 excludeCal.setTime(excludeDate);
 338	 if (calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
 339	 calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == excludeCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
 340	 isExcluded = true;
 341	 break;
 342	 }
 343	 }
 344	 }
 345	 
 346	 if (!isExcluded) {
 347	 dateList.add(currentDate);
 348	 }
 349	 
 350	 calendar.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
 351	 }
 352	
 353	 return dateList;
 354	 }

 374	 scheduleMapper.updateById(schedule);
 375

 377	 return scheduleMapper.selectById(id);
 378	 }

 1	// 文件路径: src/main/java/com/example/springboot/service/WaitlistService.java
 2	package com.example.springboot.service;
 3	
 4	import com.example.springboot.dto.WaitlistInfoDTO; // <-- [新增] 导入
 5	import com.example.springboot.entity.Schedule;
 6	import com.example.springboot.exception.CustomerException;
 7	import com.example.springboot.mapper.ScheduleMapper;
 8	import jakarta.annotation.Resource;
 9	import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate; // <-- [新增] 导入
 10	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 11	
 12	import java.util.Date;
 13	import java.util.List;
 14	import java.util.Set;
 15	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 16	
 17	@Service
 18	public class WaitlistService {
 19	
 20	 @Resource
 21	 private ScheduleMapper scheduleMapper; // <-- [保留] 仍然需要
 22	
 23	 // [修改] 注入 RedisTemplate (使用 Object, 配合 RedisConfig)
 24	 @Resource
 25	 private RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate;
 26	
 27	 // [修改] 移除 WaitlistMapper
 28	
 29	 // 定义 Redis Key 的前缀
 30	 // 候补队列 (ZSET): "waitlist:schedule:{scheduleId}" -> ZSET [ patientId, joinTime ]
 31	 private static final String WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:schedule:";
 32	 // 患者的候补列表 (SET): "waitlist:patient:{patientId}" -> SET [ "scheduleId1", "scheduleId2" ]
 33	 private static final String PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX = "waitlist:patient:";
 34	
 35	
 36	 /** [重构] 加入候补队列 (使用 Redis ZSET) */
 37	 public void addToQueue(Long patientId, Long scheduleId) {
 38	 Schedule schedule = scheduleMapper.selectById(scheduleId);
 39	 if (schedule == null) {
 40	 throw new CustomerException("排班不存在");
 41	 }
 42	 if (schedule.getAvailableSlots() != null && schedule.getAvailableSlots() > 0) {
 43	 throw new CustomerException("当前仍有号源，可直接预约");
 44	 }
 45	
 46	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 47	
 48	 // 检查是否已在队列中 (score不为null说明已存在)
 49	 Double score = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().score(key, patientId);
 50	 if (score != null) {
 51	 throw new CustomerException("已在候补队列中，请勿重复提交");
 52	 }
 53	
 54	 // 1. 加入 ZSET，分数为当前时间戳
 55	 long joinTime = new Date().getTime();
 56	 redisTemplate.opsForZSet().add(key, patientId, (double) joinTime);
 57	
 58	 // 2. 额外维护一个反向索引 (用于 "我的候补" 查询)
 59	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 60	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().add(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 61	 }
 62	
 63	 /** [重构] 弹出队首 (从 ZSET 中弹出分数最低的) */
 64	 public Long popNext(Long scheduleId) {
 65	 String key = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 66	
 67	 // 弹出分数最低（即最早加入）的 1 个元素
 68	 // 注意: popMin 返回一个包含 TypedTuple 的 Set，我们需要从中提取值
 69	 Set<Object> result = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().popMin(key, 1)
 70	 .stream()
 71	 .map(tuple -> ((org.springframework.data.redis.core.ZSetOperations.TypedTuple<Object>) tuple).getValue())
 72	 .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 73	
 74	 if (result.isEmpty()) {
 75	 return null; // 队列为空
 76	 }
 77	
 78	 // (注意: 序列化配置会导致这里可能是Integer或String)
 79	 // 确保使用 Long 类型
 80	 Long patientId = ((Number) result.iterator().next()).longValue();
 81	
 82	 // 3. (清理) 从该患者的反向索引中移除这个排班
 83	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 84	 redisTemplate.opsForSet().remove(patientKey, String.valueOf(scheduleId));
 85	
 86	 return patientId;
 87	 }
 88	
 89	 /** [重构] 根据患者ID查询候补列表 */
 90	 public List<WaitlistInfoDTO> listByPatient(Long patientId) {
 91	 String patientKey = PATIENT_KEY_PREFIX + patientId;
 92	
 93	 // 1. 获取该患者候补的所有 scheduleId
 94	 Set<Object> scheduleIdObjects = redisTemplate.opsForSet().members(patientKey);
 95	 if (scheduleIdObjects == null || scheduleIdObjects.isEmpty()) {
 96	 return List.of(); // 返回空列表
 97	 }
 98	
 99	 // 2. 遍历，查询每个队列中该 patientId 的排名
 100	 return scheduleIdObjects.stream().map(obj -> {
 101	 Long scheduleId = Long.parseLong(String.valueOf(obj));
 102	 String queueKey = WAITLIST_KEY_PREFIX + scheduleId;
 103	
 104	 // 获取我的排名 (rank 是从 0 开始的)
 105	 Long rank = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().rank(queueKey, patientId);
 106	
 107	 // 获取总排队人数
 108	 Long queueSize = redisTemplate.opsForZSet().size(queueKey);
 109	
 110	 // 如果排名为null (可能刚被弹出，但反向索引还未清除)，则跳过
 111	 if (rank == null) {
 112	 return null;
 113	 }
 114

 74	import { getMyWaitlist, cancelWaitlist } from '@/api/waitlist.js'

 77	export default {
 78		name: 'MySubstitute',
 79		data() {
 80			return {
 81				waitlists: [],
 82				currentFilter: 'all', // 默认显示全部候补记录
 83				loading: false
 84			};
 85		},
 86		computed: {
 87			// 根据筛选条件过滤列表
 88			filteredList() {
 89				if (this.currentFilter === 'all') {
 90					return this.waitlists;
 91				} else if (this.currentFilter === 'waiting') {
 92					// 只显示候补中的记录
 93					return this.waitlists.filter(item => item.status === 'WAITING');
 94				} else if (this.currentFilter === 'success') {
 95					// 只显示已成功的记录
 96					return this.waitlists.filter(item => item.status === 'SUCCESS');
 97				}
 98				return this.waitlists;
 99			}
 100		},
 101		onLoad() {
 102			// 从全局状态获取筛选条件
 103			const filter = getApp().globalData.waitlistFilter;
 104			if (filter) {
 105				this.currentFilter = filter;
 106				// 清除全局状态
 107				getApp().globalData.waitlistFilter = null;
 108			}
 109		},
 110		onShow() {
 111			// 检查是否已登录
 112			const token = this.$store.state.user.token;
 113			if (!token) {
 114				uni.showToast({ title: '请先登录', icon: 'none' });
 115				// 延迟跳转到登录页面
 116				setTimeout(() => {
 117					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login' });
 118				}, 1000);
 119				return;
 120			}
 121			
 122			this.loadData();
 123		},
 124		methods: {
 125			async loadData() {
 126				this.loading = true;
 127				try {
 128					// 获取候补记录
 129					const waitlistData = await getMyWaitlist();
 130					console.log('候补列表数据:', waitlistData);
 131	
 132					// 处理候补记录数据，并获取每个排班的详细信息
 133					if (Array.isArray(waitlistData) && waitlistData.length > 0) {
 134						// 并行获取所有排班的详细信息
 135						const detailsPromises = waitlistData.map(item =>
 136							getScheduleDetailsById(item.scheduleId)
 137								.then(details => ({
 138									...item,
 139									status: 'WAITING', // 候补状态
 140									doctorName: details.doctorName || '未知医生',
 141									scheduleDate: this.formatDate(details.scheduleDate) || '未知日期',
 142									timeSlot: details.timeSlot,
 143									timeSlotDisplay: this.getTimeSlotDisplay(details.timeSlot) || '未知时间',
 144									departmentName: details.departmentName || '未知科室'
 145								}))
 146								.catch(err => {
 147									console.error(`获取排班 ${item.scheduleId} 详情失败:`, err);
 148									// 如果获取失败，返回一个特殊状态，以便UI可以识别
 149									return {
 150										...item,
 151										status: 'ERROR',
 152										doctorName: '加载失败',
 153										scheduleDate: '请刷新重试',
 154										timeSlotDisplay: '',
 155										departmentName: ''
 156									};
 157								})
 158						);
 159	
 160						const resolvedWaitlists = await Promise.all(detailsPromises);
 161	
 162						// 检查是否有任何候补记录加载失败
 163						if (resolvedWaitlists.some(item => item.status === 'ERROR')) {
 164							uni.showToast({
 165								title: '部分候补详情加载失败，请稍后重试',
 166								icon: 'none'
 167							});
 168						}
 169	
 170						this.waitlists = resolvedWaitlists;
 171					} else {
 172						this.waitlists = [];
 173					}
 174	
 175					console.log('处理后的候补列表:', this.waitlists);
 176				} catch (e) {
 177					console.error('加载候补数据失败:', e);
 178					uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '加载失败', icon: 'none' });
 179				} finally {
 180					this.loading = false;
 181				}
 182			},
 183			// 筛选候补记录
 184			filterWaitlists(type) {
 185				this.currentFilter = type;
 186			},
 187			// 获取状态文本
 188			getStatusText(status) {
 189				switch (status) {
 190					case 'WAITING': return '候补中';
 191					case 'SUCCESS': return '已成功';
 192					case 'CANCELLED': return '已取消';
 193					default: return status || '-';
 194				}
 195			},
 196			// 获取状态样式类
 197			getStatusClass(status) {
 198				return String(status || '').toLowerCase();
 199			},
 200			// 退出候补
 201			async cancelWaitlist(item) {
 202				uni.showModal({
 203					title: '退出候补',
 204					content: '确定要退出候补吗？退出后将无法恢复',
 205					confirmText: '确认退出',
 206					confirmColor: '#f44336',
 207					success: async (res) => {
 208						if (res.confirm) {
 209							try {
 210								await cancelWaitlist(item.scheduleId);
 211								uni.showToast({ title: '已退出候补', icon: 'success' });
 212								this.loadData();
 213							} catch (e) {
 214								uni.showToast({ title: e.msg || '退出失败', icon: 'none' });
 215							}
 216						}
 217					}
 218				});
 219			},

 227			// 格式化日期
 228			formatDate(dateStr) {
 229				if (!dateStr) return '';
 230				const date = new Date(dateStr);
 231				const year = date.getFullYear();
 232				const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 233				const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 234				return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
 235			},

 237			getTimeSlotDisplay(timeSlot) {
 238				if (!timeSlot) return '';

 240				const timeSlotMap = {
 241					'morning': '上午',
 242					'afternoon': '下午',
 243					'evening': '晚上'

 245				return timeSlotMap[lowerCaseTimeSlot] || timeSlot || '';
 246			}
